parameters.query:
insert into hubspot.hubspot_contacts
select * from jsonb_populate_recordset(null::hubspot.hubspot_contacts, $1::jsonb)
on conflict (hs_object_id) do update set
  email = excluded.email,
  firstname = excluded.firstname,
  lastname = excluded.lastname,
  company = excluded.company,
  state = excluded.state,
  lifecyclestage = excluded.lifecyclestage,
  hs_lastmodifieddate = excluded.hs_lastmodifieddate,
  synced_at = excluded.synced_at
